services.name: Christmas Eve Bonfire Adventure
services.desc: A unique Christmas event! 7.25 hours About This event includes a tour at Destrehan Plantation, along with a traditional holiday dinner at Destrehan, concluding with a visit to the bonfires along the Mississippi River levee in Gramercy, LA. For many years this Cajun community has built mammoth wooden structures such as cabins, tepees, & riverboats along the Mississippi River levee. Come see the "feux de joie" (fires of joy)! Throughout this guided experience, guests will learn about Cajun and Creole Holiday Traditions, sing carols, and enjoy with cookies and eggnog. What You Get All Ages • 7 Hours & 15 Minutes • Experience Cajun Holiday Traditions!

blurb: The New Orleans Steamboat Company is no newcomer to the Mississippi River or American’s steamboat heritage. Our parent company has been operating steamboats longer than any company in the world. In fact, we’ve been part of the history of steam transport since 1817, just five years after the first steamboat docked in New Orleans.
